description: Ministry of Technology - The Personal Data Protection Act, No. 9 of 2022, Order under Sub Section (S) of Section 1
reasoning: This gazette content announces the appointment of a specific date for the commencement of Part V of the Personal Data Protection Act, No. 9 of 2022. It is a legal/regulatory matter involving the implementation of legislation, falling under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) which covers new laws, regulations, and their operational dates. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than focusing on government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
